provenance.source: Two diagonal searches and a fixed-K/g sweep of RoboCasa tabletop on one AutoDL host, built with the record command from their outputs. See issue #80 of MINT-SJTU/RoboScope-Kit.
notes: The first repeat of each probe is the search run on #81 (81e3824) merged into PR #39's branch (d26a908), the one recorded in observed_search. The second is the search on d26a908 without #81, which stopped after K=16.
Fixed runs are --concurrency K --replicas G --episodes 4 on d26a908: the same 24 work items as a probe, with 96 episodes. Each reached 55/96 successes.
Policy snapshot 30ec4b5c, StarVLA code 985c223, runtime StarVLA 2e5f239. CUDA MPS was off in every measurement here.
Fixed runs with CUDA MPS are left out, because a measurement has no MPS field: 16/2 306.7 s, 16/3 317.9 s, 20/2 345.7 s, each 55/96.
cpu_cores is the CPU quota the search saw. The host has 208 cores. The container's memory limit is 96 GiB, which the search does not read.
K=20/g=3 and K=24/g=2 failed in fixed runs when a Policy replica was killed (-9) at the container memory limit, an evaluation error rather than a probe rejection.
K=16/g=4 failed in a fixed run with CUDA out of memory, with four replicas and 16 EGL renderers on the GPU. The runtime reported repeated Worker failures.
K=32/g=2 was stopped by hand at the same memory limit and left no usable output, so it has no measurement.

All probes are diagonal probes, three work items per Worker. Default two-phase runs a fixed-size probe, which this record does not cover, so its score here only shows how it would decide on these rates.

unmeasured: Every K/g with no measurement here, including K=32/g=2, which was stopped by hand.
